purpose: Identity-only review; no model forecasts or backdated freezes.
competition_evidence: Stored PitchAPI fixture IDs, league labels and club examples, reviewed against public football-data.co.uk club vocabulary; research scope only.
limitations: No cross-provider team-ID equivalences were inferred.
Identity resolution does not establish team sample thresholds, model convergence, calibration, value or forward eligibility.
Current CSV observations must not be used at an earlier forecast cutoff.
Opaque IDs are specific to PitchAPI; numeric API-Football IDs cannot be substituted.
EC and Scottish lower divisions have authentic history but no observed PitchAPI competition IDs; no opaque IDs were guessed.
